physical.1: One limb is twisted and bent, movements turn clumsy.
physical.2: The face is warped beyond recognition; people look away.
physical.3: The feet have fused into hooves, every step is harder.
physical.4: Thick scales cover the skin: tough, but stiff to move in.
physical.5: The body swells like a wineskin, shrugging off wounds and sickness.
physical.6: Excess muscle strains the skin and hampers walking.

mental.1: A whisper in the head that does not fade even in sleep.
mental.2: Past days crumble like sand: memory keeps failing.
mental.3: Distrust of every word, betrayal seen everywhere.
mental.4: Nightly terrors steal sleep and dull the reflexes.
mental.5: Fanatic faith strengthens the will but severs ties with people.
mental.6: The mind has split in two, and one voice is not your own.
